items.title: Simone Forti’s Dance of Life
items.summary: Remembering the pioneering performance artist, who died on Wednesday at 91. Plus: Trump gives two gilded statues in DC a makeover.

items.title: Simone Forti, Artist of Movement and Chance, Dies at 91
items.summary: The Italian-born choreographer and performance artist mixed boundless curiosity with a formal rigor across a broad creative spectrum that spanned New York, Los Angeles, and Rome.

items.title: Trump Regilds DC Statues Mar-a-Lago Style
items.summary: The sprucing up of the "Arts of War" and "Arts of Peace" equestrian statues cost the public $5 million in a no-bid contract.

items.title: Why Did Rembrandt Die Poor?
items.summary: Rembrandt pioneered the saleable self, but unlike his rival, Gerard Van Honthorst, failed to reconcile his personal vision with the market.
